user.title: EnOcean stick
user.description: Select the EnOcean USB stick (USB300 or compatible) plugged into Home Assistant.

usb_confirm.title: EnOcean stick detected
usb_confirm.description: An EnOcean stick was detected on {path}. Do you want to use it?

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the EnOcean stick
reconfigure.description:
Current port: `{current}`.

Choose the new port of the stick, or type its path (e.g. /dev/serial/by-id/usb-EnOcean_GmbH_EnOcean_USB_300_...). Paired products are kept.

reconfigure_new_key.title: New EnOcean stick detected
reconfigure_new_key.description:
This port belongs to **another stick** (ID {new} instead of {old}).

- **Sensors and switches** will keep working.
- **Relay modules and plugs** are bound to the old stick: remove them and add them again (pairing).

Submit to adopt the new stick?

error.cannot_open: Cannot open the serial port ({error}). It is probably already used by another integration or add-on (native EnOcean integration, EnOcean MQTT add-on…).
error.no_response: The port opens but the stick does not answer (EnOcean ESP3 protocol). Check that it is the EnOcean stick and that no add-on is using it.
error.native_enocean: The native Home Assistant EnOcean integration is active: remove it first, otherwise the stick stays busy.

abort.already_configured: This EnOcean stick is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The EnOcean stick has been reconfigured.

user.title: Add a NodOn product
user.description:
{gallery}

Choose the NodOn product to add. Everything is preconfigured: nothing else to fill in.

instructions.title: {model} — {name}

timeout.title: No product detected
timeout.description:
No pairing request from the **{model}** was received.

- Move the product closer to the EnOcean stick (less than 10 m while pairing).
- Check that it is powered (or exposed to light for solar sensors).
- Repeat the steps: {instructions}

data.action: What do you want to do?

manual.title: Manual entry
manual.description: Enter the 8-character EnOcean ID printed on the product or its packaging (e.g. 0512AB34).

confirm.title: Product detected!

data_description.name: For example “EnOcean Smart Plug NodOn”.
data_description.area_id: Existing area where the product is installed (optional).
data_description.new_area: If the area does not exist yet, type its name (e.g. “Garage”): it will be created.

abort.gateway_not_ready: The EnOcean stick is not ready. Check its connection and try again.

gateway_unavailable.title: EnOcean stick unreachable
gateway_unavailable.description:
NodOcean for HA cannot use the EnOcean stick on `{port}` ({error}).

- Check that the stick is plugged in.
- Check that no other integration or add-on uses it.
- If the port changed, use **Reconfigure** on the NodOcean for HA integration.

Home Assistant retries automatically; this message disappears as soon as the stick answers.

native_enocean.title: The EnOcean stick is used by the native EnOcean integration
native_enocean.description:
NodOcean for HA cannot open `{port}` ({error}) and Home Assistant's native **EnOcean** integration is active.

A stick can only serve one integration: remove the native EnOcean integration (Settings → Devices & services), then restart Home Assistant.

mqtt_no_ha_mqtt.title: MQTT bridge: MQTT integration missing
mqtt_no_ha_mqtt.description:
The NodOcean for HA MQTT bridge is set to use the broker of the Home Assistant MQTT integration, but it is not set up.

Set up the MQTT integration, or enter the broker address in **Configure** on the EnOcean stick.

mqtt_no_host.title: MQTT bridge: broker address missing
mqtt_no_host.description: The MQTT bridge is enabled but no broker address is set. Open **Configure** on the EnOcean stick.

init.title: MQTT bridge (NodOcean to MQTT)
init.description:
Sends the state of NodOn products to an MQTT broker (local or remote) and lets you control them, like Zigbee2MQTT.

Topics: `nodocean/product_name` (JSON state), `…/set` (commands), `…/action` (buttons), `nodocean/bridge/state`. Details in the [wiki]({wiki}).

The connection is tested when you submit.

data.mqtt_use_ha: Use the broker of the Home Assistant MQTT integration

data_description.mqtt_use_ha: Reuses the address, port and credentials of the MQTT integration already set up. The fields below are then ignored.
data_description.mqtt_password: Leave empty to keep the saved password.

data.mqtt_tls_insecure: Do not verify the broker certificate

data_description.mqtt_client_id: Leave empty: nodocean- followed by the stick ID.
data_description.mqtt_ca: File path on Home Assistant (e.g. /ssl/ca.crt). Empty: system certificates.
data_description.mqtt_tls_insecure: Avoid: only for a self-signed test certificate.
data_description.mqtt_telegrams: For debugging: every telegram received or sent is published to nodocean/bridge/telegrams.
data_description.mqtt_discovery: For ANOTHER Home Assistant connected to this broker: products show up there automatically. On this Home Assistant they would appear twice.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the broker {broker}. Check the address, port and TLS.
error.invalid_auth: The broker {broker} rejects the username or password.
error.tls_error: TLS error: certificate unreadable or rejected.
error.no_ha_mqtt: The Home Assistant MQTT integration is not set up.
